reasonToGo: One crossing serves the whole land, and everything waiting on it has to be fed, stabled and ferried here.

hazards.name: High water at the ford
hazards.description: In thaw the ford goes under and the carts stop where they stand. Nothing crosses until the ferrymen say it crosses.
hazards.note: Absence hazard: ground that cannot be crossed is a wall, not a tick. No runtime zoneHazards type fits.

hazards.name: The millrace
hazards.description: A cut channel running fast and flat under the wheel housing. The current hides the shape of whatever is standing in it.
hazards.note: Absence hazard: a current is not in the seven-value enum, and `damage` would read as a burn or a bite.

resources.name: Race-milled grain
resources.description: Grain brought in by cart and ground at the race. The dust of it settles on every yard behind the mill.

resources.name: The quarry face
resources.description: Cut stone off the face west of the town, worked in lifts by crews who down tools when the beetles come up.

landmarks.name: The cart queue
landmarks.description: The first thing on the road: waggons standing nose to tail, sometimes a mile out from the town.

landmarks.name: The mill-wheel housing
landmarks.description: The one tall thing in the town, timber and iron over the race, and the only roof visible from the far bank.
